svg.title: ATLANTIS — 16-bit bronze ambigram
svg.desc: 16-bit bronze ambigram with tighter optical letter spacing. Original glyph shapes retained on a 3-unit pixel grid. Nine editable letter layers and independent color paths. Transparent background. Visible geometry and palette are 180-degree symmetric about (612,144). Hidden smooth vector master has matching spacing. No bitmap, fonts, external assets or filters.
